title: Gatik raises $200M to scale AI-powered autonomous freight
summary: Gatik, an autonomous trucking company, raised $200 million in Series D funding led by Qatar Investment Authority and Koch Disruptive Technologies to scale its AI-powered driverless freight operations across North America. The company has now secured over $600 million in total funding, demonstrating strong investor confidence in autonomous freight solutions.
problem_solved: Addresses the trucking industry driver shortage and the demand for efficient, round-the-clock freight transportation without human drivers.
why_valuable: Enables 24/7 autonomous freight delivery, reducing labor costs, improving supply chain reliability, and accelerating the commercialization of autonomous logistics at scale.
